basis: Codex review #3 (verified accurate 2026-08-20): the frozen 6,657-row kinyarwanda pool served checkpoint selection (100-row slice, all inside the pool), full-pool evaluation, threshold revision, and v1 promotion - repeated decision exposure makes it a de-facto development set. Winner's-curse inflation on a 20-checkpoint sweep (~0.5-1.5% relative) can swing the >9.3% ship decision.
pool_demotion: eval/kinyarwanda/asr/cv17-test-v1 (6,657 rows) is DEMOTED to development use: checkpoint selection and diagnostics only. It backs no further promotion claim.

sealed_holdout.construction: deterministic speaker-disjoint split of the r2 pool: speakers ordered by sha256('kw-sealed-holdout-2026-08-20' + speaker_id), assigned to SEALED until >= half the rows; never previously used for any per-half decision

freeze_audit_vs_gb5_training.note: 64 of 1,018,628 training rows (0.006%) share exact normalized text - common short phrases, no audio/speaker identity

sealed_holdout.consumption_rule: evaluated EXACTLY ONCE, after v2 checkpoint selection is complete and the selected checkpoint is declared in writing; any second evaluation voids the seal and requires a new holdout

dev_half.use: v2 checkpoint selection (sweep) alongside the demoted pool

predeclared_ship_rule: SHIP v2 IFF: on the SEALED holdout, with BOTH models scored in the same pinned eval image (medzen-asr-eval-runtime@sha256:dafc4b14...) under identical decode config, (WER_v1_sealed - WER_v2_sealed) / WER_v1_sealed > 0.093. v1 = approved/kinyarwanda/asr/v1/model.pt. No threshold revision after observing sealed results.
confirmatory_set: FLEURS has no kinyarwanda (verified: 0 of 102 configs). Independent-source candidates (AfriVoice Kinyarwanda, Mbaza hackathon set) require licence diligence - tracked as a follow-up; DIRECTIONAL check only, does not gate this ship decision.
sequence: v2 job completes -> sweep 20 checkpoints on dev half + demoted pool -> declare selected checkpoint in the shared file -> single sealed-holdout run scoring v1 and the selected v2 -> apply predeclared rule -> record verdict
